name: whoami
title: Who am I
description: Identify the credential calling this server: which project and organization it can reach. Call this first, since most tools act on a project and this tells you which one you have.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: List the projects this credential can reach, with their ids and slugs. Use the returned id as projectId for other operations.

name: get_project_overview
title: Project overview
description: Counts of skills and active experiments for a project, plus whether it has ingested any telemetry yet. The best first call to orient in a project.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

name: list_skills
title: List skills
description: Skills in the project catalog with their status, tags, and a preview of the body. Filter by status or end user. Use get_skill for a full body.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

endUserId.description: Restrict to a single end user id, when the project segments by one.

name: get_skill
title: Get skill
description: One skill in full, including the complete body text and both descriptions.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: get_catalog_status
title: Catalog status
description: One-call health check for a project's catalog: how many skills and tools exist, how many tools carry a usable description, the published catalog version, and whether the runtime has adopted it.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: list_declared_tools
title: Tools the runtime declares
description: Tools the runtime has declared to Ratel, with their definitions and freshness. Flags any with no description text, which is the single most common reason a tool is never retrieved. This is what the runtime says exists; list_invoked_tools is what telemetry has seen actually called.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: list_invoked_tools
title: Tools telemetry has seen called
description: Tools telemetry has actually seen invoked, with call counts, token usage, cost, and last-seen time. Compare against list_declared_tools to find declared-but-unused or used-but-undeclared tools.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: list_catalog_overrides
title: List retrieval-description overrides
description: Searchable-description overrides set in Ratel for runtime catalog entries, which replace the description the runtime would otherwise match on.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: get_trace_health
title: Latency and error rate
description: Headline health over a window, from spans: trace count, error rate, p50 and p95 latency, plus token and cost totals. The cheapest answer to how a project is performing. For spend questions prefer get_cost_by_day, which reads the metrics the customer sees on their own dashboard and works even when trace surfaces are off.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

includeDaily.description: Also return a per-day series over the window.

name: list_traces
title: List traces
description: Recent traces with duration, status, span count, token usage and cost. Filter by model, tool, experiment, or errors only. Use get_trace to open one.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

errorOnly.description: Only traces containing an error span.

includeFacets.description: Also return the available filter values for this window.

name: get_trace
title: Get trace
description: The span breakdown for one trace: each span's name, kind, status, duration and token counts. Span payload bodies are deliberately not returned.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: list_span_groups
title: Spans grouped by model, tool or operation
description: Span statistics grouped by operation name, model, or tool: call counts, error counts, latency and token usage. The one to reach for when the question is which model or tool dominates, and the only grouped view carrying latency. For per-tool token and cost totals that match the dashboard, prefer get_cost_by_tool.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

errorOnly.description: Only traces containing an error span.

name: get_span_totals
title: Span totals for a filtered slice
description: One row of span totals for a filtered slice: span count, error count, token totals and cost. Use it to size a specific slice (one model, one tool, errors only) rather than to browse. Same source as get_trace_health, so prefer that one for latency percentiles, or get_cost_by_day for spend.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

errorOnly.description: Only traces containing an error span.

name: get_cost_by_day
title: Cost and tokens per day
description: Per-day token counts and cost from the derived event metrics, broken down by context source. This is the series the project home page and dashboard render, so it is the number to quote for spend, and it is available whether or not trace surfaces are enabled. Use the span-based tools instead for latency or individual requests.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

name: get_cost_by_tool
title: Cost and tokens per tool
description: Token and call totals per tool over a window, from the derived event metrics, which is the source to quote for per-tool spend. Ratel gateway meta-tools are marked so they are not mistaken for the agent's own. Use list_span_groups grouped by tool instead when you need latency or error counts per tool.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

name: get_traces_ingest_diagnostics
title: Trace ingest diagnostics
description: What the ingest endpoint has actually received for this project, and why spans may have been dropped. The first thing to check when a project appears to have no telemetry.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: list_calibrations
title: List calibrations
description: Experiments in this project that recorded ranking comparisons, with how many selections were compared and how many disagreed. The starting point for calibration work: find the experiment with a mismatch rate worth explaining, then open it with get_calibration.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

name: get_calibration
title: Calibration detail
description: How two arms of one experiment agreed over a window: per-arm-pair comparison counts, mismatch counts, top-1 and exact-order agreement rates, and a sample of recent comparisons. Use list_calibration_mismatches to see only the ones that disagreed.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

experimentName.description: Experiment name, as returned by list_calibrations.

name: list_calibration_mismatches
title: Calibration mismatches
description: The individual real queries where two arms returned different rankings, with both rankings and how they differ. This is the concrete work list for improving retrieval: take a query from here, reproduce it with test_retrieval, and test a description change against it.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

facets.description: Narrow to particular kinds of disagreement.

includeAgreements.description: Also return selections where the two arms agreed.

name: list_match_quality_runs
title: List match quality runs
description: Past analyses of search quality, each with the evidence census that bounds how much its proposals are worth. Read the census before the proposals: a run over a window with no invoked-tool records measured agreement with the baseline, not accuracy.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: get_match_quality_run
title: Get match quality run
description: One match quality analysis in full: what the run could see, what it concluded, and the searchable-description rewrites it proposed. Omit runId for the most recent run. Apply a proposal with set_catalog_override.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: list_tool_cousage
title: List tool co-usage
description: Tools that run together in the same turn or the same session, from real invocations: each set with how many units ran it, the task it is when its tools are a task's steps (taskId), and for pairs the overlap and each direction's conditional share. mergeCandidatesOnly keeps the pairs the agent never runs apart.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

scope.description: turn: tools called in one turn; session: tools called anywhere in one session.

size.description: Only sets of exactly this many tools (sets reach as many tools as the biggest task).

minSupport.description: Only sets seen in at least this many units.

tool.description: Only sets containing this tool id.

mergeCandidatesOnly.description: Only pairs with Jaccard lower bound >= 0.9 and support >= 20.

name: list_tool_transitions
title: List tool transitions
description: What the agent runs after a given tool, from real invocations: next-tool probabilities with confidence bounds and lift, in one turn or across a session, the order a task's steps run in. kind=next is the call right after; kind=before is any later call in the same unit.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

from.description: Only transitions leaving this tool id.

to.description: Only transitions arriving at this tool id.

minN.description: Only transitions seen at least this many times.

name: list_intent_tool_usage
title: List intent tool usage
description: Which tools serve each kind of search the agent makes: for every intent grouped from real search queries, the tools the agent went on to call in the same turn or session, as a share of that intent's units with a confidence bound. Rows group by intent, biggest first.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

intentId.description: Only this intent: an intentId from an earlier page of this list.

minUnits.description: Only intents carried by at least this many units.

name: list_tool_crafts
title: List drafted fixes
description: Fixes drafted by rules from how the agent runs its tools: merge tools it never runs apart, combine a task's steps into one tool, tighten a schema whose first calls fail, retire a tool nobody calls, rewrite a description searches miss. Each row has the kind of fix, the tools it changes, the drafted tool and its fixId on Fixes.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: get_tool_craft
title: Get a drafted fix
description: One drafted fix in full: the evidence, the tools as they are today, and the drafted definition (JSON, TypeScript and Python).

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: get_flag_status
title: Feature flag status
description: Kept for agents that call it: every Ratel surface is on for every organization, so this always returns an empty list. An empty result from any other tool means there is no data, not a switched-off surface.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: get_quota_status
title: Plan limits
description: The organization's plan, its numeric limits (projects, skills per project, members), and current usage against each. Explains quota_exceeded errors on writes.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: get_job_status
title: Background job status
description: Status of a background job by id, or every job currently queued or running for the project. Analysis work such as a match quality run is queued, so poll this rather than assuming it failed.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

jobId.description: A specific job id, as returned by an operation that enqueues work.

name: get_improvement_signals
title: What to fix
description: The single best starting point for improving a catalog: skills that get retrieved in search but never actually invoked, the most common user queries, and the tools erroring most often.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window. Defaults per operation.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the window. Defaults to now.

endUserId.description: Restrict to a single end user id, when the project segments by one.

name: list_search_queries_for_skill
title: Queries that retrieved a skill
description: The real user queries that caused a given skill to be retrieved. The fastest way to see whether a skill's description is matching the intent you meant it to. Identify the skill by name, as the runtime does.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

skillName.description: The skill's name, as it appears in the catalog and in retrieval telemetry.

endUserId.description: Restrict to a single end user id, when the project segments by one.

name: test_retrieval
title: Test retrieval against the live catalog
description: Rank a query against this project's real catalog, once as stored and once with proposed description edits applied, and return the difference. Nothing is written: this is how to check a rewrite fixes a query before saving it with update_skill or set_catalog_override. Mode bm25 is free; embeddings and hybrid call the embedding provider, cost money, and are metered tighter.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

query.description: The prompt to rank, ideally a real one from calibration or search history.

mode.description: bm25 is free; embeddings and hybrid spend the embedding provider budget.

embeddingWeight.description: How much the embedding score counts in hybrid mode.

drafts.description: Unsaved edits to test, keyed by skill name or tool name. Send only the kind you are editing. Omit entirely to rank the catalog as it stands.

description.description: Replacement retrieval text to test. Not saved.
Replacement retrieval text to test. Not saved.

includeSyncedTools.description: Include runtime-synced tool definitions in the bench.

name: create_skill
title: Create skill
description: Add a skill to the project catalog. Subject to the organization's skills-per-project plan limit. Creates as a draft unless status is set to published.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: update_skill
title: Update skill
description: Change one or more fields of an existing skill. Pass expectedVersion to make the edit conditional on the version you read, which is how concurrent edits are detected.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: publish_skill
title: Publish skill
description: Move a skill to published so the retrieval engine can serve it. Publishing bumps the project's catalog version.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: archive_skill
title: Archive skill
description: Move a skill to archived so it stops being served. Archiving is reversible by publishing again; it does not delete the skill.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: import_skills
title: Import skills
description: Bulk upsert skills by name: each one is created if absent, updated if its content differs, and left alone if identical. Made for onboarding an existing folder of skill files in one call. The plan limit is checked against the whole batch first, so an import that would exceed it changes nothing at all.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

name: set_catalog_override
title: Override a catalog entry's searchable description
description: Replace the searchable description of one runtime-synced catalog entry, which is the text retrieval matches against. Use it to make a tool findable when the runtime's own description is thin or absent. Pass null to clear the override and fall back to what the runtime reported. Does not change the description the agent reads.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.

kind.description: Which catalog the entry belongs to, as reported by list_declared_tools.

searchableDescription.description: The replacement text, or null to clear the override.

name: generate_tool_crafts
title: Draft fixes
description: Queues a drafting run: rules read how the agent runs its tools, its tasks and the searches that missed a tool, and draft fixes (merges, combined steps, tighter schemas, prerequisites, rewrites, retirements and more). No model is called. Returns a jobId; poll get_job_status, then list_tool_crafts.

projectId.description: Project to act on. Optional when authenticating with a project API key, which implies it.
